children: New DeKalb County location will host grand opening celebration Thursday, September 10
) ("Trulieve" or "the Company"), a leading and top-performing medical cannabis company in the U.S., today announced the opening of a new medical cannabis dispensary in Dunwoody, Georgia.

"This new DeKalb County dispensary expands access to medical cannabis for patients throughout Metro Atlanta," said Trulieve Chief Executive Officer Kim Rivers. "We are excited to serve the Dunwoody community and provide patients with Trulieve's high-quality products and exceptional customer experiences."
A grand opening celebration will be held Thursday, September 10, featuring a ribbon cutting ceremony at 9:30 a.m., food truck, storewide discounts, and merchandise giveaways.

Trulieve Dunwoody, located at 4675 N. Shallowford Road, Suite 100, is open 10 a.m. – 7 p.m. Sunday through Thursday, and 10 a.m. – 8 p.m. Friday and Saturday. The dispensary offers a wide selection of popular products from Trulieve's in-house brands Modern Flower, Momenta, Roll One, and Trulieve, in a variety of formats including capsules, inhalable flower, tinctures, topicals, troches, and vaporizers.
Trulieve offers several free resources on its website to help educate potential patients including its

tool, a free database of authorized physicians offering medical cannabis card evaluations in their area, and information on how to become a registered patient in Georgia. For more information on Trulieve's Georgia retail store locations and pharmacy partners click here and follow us on Instagram @Trulieve.GA to stay connected.

Trulieve is an industry leading, vertically integrated cannabis company and multi-state operator in the U.S., with established medical marijuana operations in Florida, Georgia, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia. Driven by a core mission to expand access to cannabis, Trulieve serves customers with innovative, high-quality branded products and exceptional experiences. With scaled operations in attractive markets and targeted expansion through its hub strategy, Trulieve is poised for accelerated growth. Trulieve is listed on the NYSE under the symbol TRLV. For more information, please visit Trulieve.com.
Christine Hersey, Chief Corporate Affairs and Strategy Officer
